name: devloom-agent
description: DevLoom host agent — Claude bridge, git/repos, and the embedded-terminal PTY.
comment: Deps are ONLY needed for the embedded terminal (claude-cli). The HTTP endpoints run on Node built-ins alone — `node devloom-agent.mjs` works without npm install. For the terminal, run `npm install` here (node-pty ships prebuilt N-API binaries, so no build tools needed on Win/macOS/Linux).
